values.note: Orange County Fee Directory, effective 10/1/26: site rental $18 a night (6 people, 2 vehicles, power and water), $23 for non-county residents; +$2 a night per additional person, +$3 per additional vehicle. Primitive sites $15. Cancelling less than three days ahead costs one night.

fees.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf (Camping and Related Fees, 'Site Rental, per night, (6 people, 1 dump, 2 vehicles, power and water) $18.00', 'Site Rental (non County resident) 23.00', effective 10/1/26), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/CultureParks/Parks.aspx?m=dtlvw&d=40 ('Recreational vehicles cannot exceed a maximum length of 35 feet or maximum height of 12 feet'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Individual campsites book online only (OCPORTAL, Orange County's WebTrac), no more than 45 days ahead; not by phone or email. Family, group and handicap campsites are booked by calling the park. Campers must check in and set up before the park closes (8 p.m. Mar-Oct, 6 p.m. Nov-Feb). Campgrounds close at noon Dec 23 and reopen at 2 p.m. Dec 26.

booking.source: https://www.orangecountyfl.net/CultureParks/CampingEnvironmentalEducation.aspx ('Clarcona, Kelly, Moss, Magnolia and Trimble Parks accept online reservations for individual campsites no more than 45-days prior to your stay'; 'reservations are not accepted over the phone or by email. For family campsites, group campsites, handicap campsites ... please call ... Trimble 407-254-1982') + https://florangectyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN (check-in and holiday-closure notices), read 2026-10-21

note: Orange County park on a peninsula between Lake Beauclair and Lake Carlton (Harris Chain); sites have power and water. Small and popular, book early. Pets allowed with registration. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm max RV 35 ft and online booking (WebTrac) up to 45 days ahead; added fees $18/night ($23 non-county resident, FY2026-27 fee directory). Not stated: site count, amperage, sewer (15 sites / water from the note left).
